summary: Adamas Trust, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release dated September 10, 2026, in which its Board of Directors declared cash dividends on four series of cumulative redeemable preferred stock — the 8.00% Series D, 7.875% Series E, 6.875% Series F and 7.000% Series G — for the dividend period beginning July 15, 2026 and ending October 14, 2026. No stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural transaction terms are stated. This is a routine preferred dividend declaration, not a special situation; monitoring is limited to ordinary dividend-payment mechanics and preferred cash-flow coverage.
